title: Note page
summary: A static informational page: a heading and a block of prose in a card. No data, no callbacks - the page-type building block for a one-off About/Overview/Summary page.

props.name: config
props.description: { heading, body, cardHeading }. heading is the page's h1 text, body is the card's prose, cardHeading is an optional card title (the card has no header without it).

parts.name: body
parts.description: Wraps the built pk-stack > pk-heading + pk-card content.

a11y: The heading is a real pk-heading (h1); the card's body is a plain paragraph.

examples.title: About page (set config from script: an inline script cannot run under this site's CSP, so wire it the way pk-tool-page's run is wired)
